```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The kableExtra package is required to format the Script 05 QC report.")
}

diagnostic_file <- params$diagnostic_file

options(knitr.kable.NA = "—")

validate_file_parameter <- function(path, parameter_name) {
  if (
    !is.character(path) ||
    length(path) != 1L ||
    is.na(path) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(path))
  ) {
    stop("The ", parameter_name, " parameter must contain one nonempty character file path.")
  }

  path <- path.expand(path)

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(parameter_name, " file not found: ", path)
  }

  if (dir.exists(path)) {
    stop(parameter_name, " identifies a directory rather than a file: ", path)
  }

  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

diagnostic_file <- validate_file_parameter(
  path = diagnostic_file,
  parameter_name = "diagnostic_file"
)

normalization_qc <- readRDS(diagnostic_file)

if (!is.list(normalization_qc)) {
  stop("The Script 05 diagnostic RDS must contain a list.")
}

required_sections <- c(
  "metadata", "input", "derivations", "driving_pressure", "analysis_frames", "discordance",
  "reclassification", "prognostic_utility", "mechanic_modification", "encompassing_analysis",
  "normalization_specifications", "expansion_validation", "nonreport_output_manifest",
  "descriptive_weight_comparison", "warnings", "checks"
)

missing_sections <- setdiff(required_sections, names(normalization_qc))

if (length(missing_sections) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The Script 05 diagnostic RDS is missing required section(s): ",
    paste(missing_sections, collapse = ", "),
    ". Rerun Script 05 through the encompassing analysis before rendering this report."
  )
}

show_table <- function(
  x,
  digits = 2,
  empty_text = "No records to display.",
  landscape = FALSE,
  character_width = "3.2cm",
  landscape_section = FALSE,
  first_column_width_cm = NULL
) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output("*Diagnostic not available.*\n\n"))
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
  }

  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(knitr::asis_output(paste0("*", empty_text, "*\n\n")))
  }

  for (flag in list(landscape, landscape_section)) {
    if (!is.logical(flag) || length(flag) != 1L || is.na(flag)) {
      stop("Landscape arguments must be TRUE or FALSE.")
    }
  }

  if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("kableExtra is required for diagnostic-report table formatting.")
  }

  x <- tibble::as_tibble(x)
  latex_output <- knitr::is_latex_output()

  # Retain the existing PDF-only presentation of intercept labels.
  if (latex_output) {
    x <- x %>%
      mutate(across(
        where(is.character),
        ~ if_else(.x == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", .x)
      ))
  }

  # Display headings only; saved diagnostic column names remain unchanged.
  heading_labels <- names(x) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      c(
        "hospitalizations" = "hosp",
        "hospitalization" = "hosp",
        "measurements" = "values",
        "measurement" = "value",
        "percentage" = "pct",
        "percent" = "pct",
        "minimum" = "min",
        "maximum" = "max"
      )
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("_", " ")

  long_table <- nrow(x) > 30L
  landscape_table <- latex_output && (landscape || landscape_section)

  table_output <- knitr::kable(
    x,
    col.names = heading_labels,
    digits = digits,
    booktabs = latex_output,
    longtable = latex_output && long_table,
    escape = TRUE
  )

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    table_output <- table_output %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "responsive"),
        full_width = FALSE,
        position = "left",
        font_size = 10
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%")
  }

  if (latex_output) {
    width_budget_cm <- if (landscape_table) 20 else 13

    table_output <- table_output %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = if (long_table) "repeat_header" else "hold_position",
        font_size = if (landscape_table || ncol(x) > 7L) 7 else 8,
        position = "left"
      )

    column_weights <- vapply(
      x,
      function(column) {
        if (is.character(column) || is.factor(column)) 2 else 1
      },
      numeric(1)
    )

    if (
      !is.character(character_width) ||
      length(character_width) != 1L ||
      is.na(character_width) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?cm$", character_width)
    ) {
      stop("character_width must be a positive width expressed in cm.")
    }

    requested_character_width <- as.numeric(sub("cm$", "", character_width))
    if (!is.finite(requested_character_width) || requested_character_width <= 0) {
      stop("character_width must be positive.")
    }

    if (is.null(first_column_width_cm)) {
      first_label <- tolower(trimws(heading_labels[[1L]]))
      first_is_text <- is.character(x[[1L]]) || is.factor(x[[1L]])

      first_column_width_cm <- if (
        grepl("derivation|filter step|exclusion reason|interpretation", first_label)
      ) {
        4.5
      } else if (grepl("^device$|device category", first_label)) {
        2.5
      } else if (!first_is_text) {
        1.8
      } else {
        requested_character_width
      }
    }

    if (
      !is.numeric(first_column_width_cm) ||
      length(first_column_width_cm) != 1L ||
      is.na(first_column_width_cm) ||
      !is.finite(first_column_width_cm) ||
      first_column_width_cm <= 0 ||
      first_column_width_cm >= width_budget_cm
    ) {
      stop("first_column_width_cm must be positive and below the table budget.")
    }

    if (ncol(x) == 1L) {
      column_widths_cm <- first_column_width_cm
    } else {
      remaining_weights <- column_weights[-1L]
      column_widths_cm <- c(
        first_column_width_cm,
        (width_budget_cm - first_column_width_cm) *
          remaining_weights / sum(remaining_weights)
      )
    }

    for (column_number in seq_len(ncol(x))) {
      table_output <- kableExtra::column_spec(
        table_output,
        column = column_number,
        width = paste0(
          formatC(
            column_widths_cm[[column_number]],
            format = "f",
            digits = 2
          ),
          "cm"
        )
      )
    }

    if (landscape_table && !landscape_section) {
      table_output <- kableExtra::landscape(table_output)
    }
  }

  table_output
}

validate_report_checks <- function(checks) {
  if (!is.list(checks) || length(checks) == 0L) {
    stop("Report integrity checks must be a nonempty list.")
  }

  check_names <- names(checks)

  if (
    is.null(check_names) ||
    anyNA(check_names) ||
    any(!nzchar(trimws(check_names))) ||
    anyDuplicated(check_names)
  ) {
    stop("Report integrity checks must have unique, nonempty names.")
  }

  valid_shapes <- vapply(
    checks,
    function(value) is.logical(value) && length(value) == 1L,
    logical(1)
  )

  if (!all(valid_shapes)) {
    stop(
      "Malformed report integrity check(s): ",
      paste(check_names[!valid_shapes], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Missing logical results are retained as REVIEW, never treated as PASS.
  vapply(checks, function(value) value[[1]], logical(1))
}

checks_to_table <- function(checks) {
  check_values <- validate_report_checks(checks)

  tibble(
    check = names(check_values),
    passed = unname(check_values)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      check = str_replace_all(check, "_", " ") %>%
        str_to_sentence(),
      status = if_else(passed %in% TRUE, "PASS", "REVIEW")
    ) %>%
    select(check, status)
}

summarize_checks <- function(checks, area) {
  check_values <- validate_report_checks(checks)

  tibble(
    QC_area = area,
    n_checks = length(check_values),
    n_passed = sum(check_values %in% TRUE),
    n_review = sum(!(check_values %in% TRUE)),
    status = if_else(all(check_values %in% TRUE), "PASS", "REVIEW")
  )
}

safe_rows <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || !is.data.frame(x)) 0L else nrow(x)
}

runtime_check_summary <- summarize_checks(normalization_qc$checks, "Script 05 runtime and output checks")

overall_computational_status <- if (runtime_check_summary$status == "PASS") {
  "PASS"
} else {
  "REVIEW"
}

warning_count <- if (is.null(normalization_qc$warnings)) {
  0L
} else {
  sum(purrr::map_int(normalization_qc$warnings, safe_rows))
}

if (!is.list(normalization_qc$metadata)) {
  stop("Normalization diagnostic metadata must be a list.")
}

saved_site <- normalization_qc$metadata$site

if (
  !is.character(saved_site) ||
  length(saved_site) != 1L ||
  is.na(saved_site) ||
  !nzchar(trimws(saved_site))
) {
  stop("Normalization diagnostic metadata must contain one nonempty character site label.")
}

report_site <- params$site_name

if (is.null(report_site)) {
  report_site <- saved_site
} else {
  if (
    !is.character(report_site) ||
    length(report_site) != 1L ||
    is.na(report_site) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(report_site))
  ) {
    stop("The site_name parameter must be null or one nonempty character site label.")
  }

  if (!identical(report_site, saved_site)) {
    stop(
      "Report site_name does not match the saved normalization diagnostics: ",
      report_site,
      " versus ",
      saved_site,
      "."
    )
  }
}
```

# Automated analytical review items

```{r}
#| results: asis

review_items <- character()

initial_warnings <- normalization_qc$warnings$initial

if (!is.null(initial_warnings) && nrow(initial_warnings) > 0L) {
  review_items <- c(review_items, initial_warnings$interpretation)
}

if (
  !is.null(normalization_qc$discordance$age_pattern$linear_summary) &&
    any(normalization_qc$discordance$age_pattern$linear_summary$nonlinearity_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "The PBW/PFVC relationship with age was nonlinear; the annual log-linear estimate is an average summary."
  )
}

spline_heterogeneity <- normalization_qc$discordance$age_pattern$heterogeneity$spline_nested_model_comparison

if (
  !is.null(spline_heterogeneity) &&
    "Pr(>F)" %in% names(spline_heterogeneity) &&
    any(spline_heterogeneity$`Pr(>F)` < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    "The nonlinear PBW/PFVC age pattern differed jointly by sex or race in the spline interaction analysis."
  )
}

prognostic_family_status <- normalization_qc$prognostic_utility$family_status

if (!is.null(prognostic_family_status)) {
  if (any(str_detect(prognostic_family_status$family_comparison_status, fixed("Exploratory")), na.rm = TRUE)) {
    review_items <- c(
      review_items,
      paste0(
        "At least one mechanic-family/alternative/adjustment comparison set was computationally usable ",
        "but flagged as event-limited. Its results remain exploratory."
      )
    )
  }

  if (any(str_detect(prognostic_family_status$family_comparison_status, fixed("Suppressed")), na.rm = TRUE)) {
    review_items <- c(
      review_items,
      paste0(
        "At least one mechanic-family/alternative/adjustment comparison set failed the existing computational-use ",
        "criteria. AIC, AUC, and delta AIC were suppressed for that five-model set. ",
        "Mechanic-coefficient exports use individual model status and may remain available for other models in the set."
      )
    )
  }
}

encompassing_warnings <- normalization_qc$warnings$encompassing_collinearity

if (!is.null(encompassing_warnings) && nrow(encompassing_warnings) > 0L) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    paste0(
      "At least one both-size encompassing model had a high maximum design-column VIF. ",
      "This flags related model predictors but does not identify PBW and PFVC as the sole source of collinearity. ",
      "Individual size coefficients require cautious interpretation; no model or observation was removed by this flag."
    )
  )
}

modifier_status <- normalization_qc$mechanic_modification$single_modifier_curves$status

if (!is.null(modifier_status) && any(!modifier_status$estimable)) {
  review_items <- c(
    review_items,
    paste0(
      sum(!modifier_status$estimable), " of ", nrow(modifier_status),
      " single-modifier curve panels were suppressed by the prespecified display criteria."
    )
  )
}

if (length(review_items) == 0L) {
  cat("No automated analytical review items were identified.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("- ", unique(review_items)), sep = "\n")
}
```

# PBW/PFVC conversion-factor discordance

PBW/PFVC is a unit-bearing conversion factor in kg/L. Dividing PBW/PFVC by 10
gives the numerical ratio between VT/PFVC expressed as percent and VT/PBW
expressed as mL/kg. This scaling does not imply that 10 kg/L is biologically
normal or ideal.

```{=latex}
\BeginDiagnosticLandscape
```

# Descriptive comparison of three weight methods

These comparisons use McLaren predicted body weight, NCHS predicted weight, and
actual body weight. Actual body weight is measured weight, not a predicted body
weight method.

Samples are method-specific within the existing descriptive cohort. A missing
method weight does not exclude that patient from another method. Metric-specific
samples may also differ, so reclassification percentages must be interpreted
with their denominators.

```{r}
descriptive_weight_qc <- normalization_qc$descriptive_weight_comparison

if (
  !is.list(descriptive_weight_qc) ||
  !is.list(descriptive_weight_qc$reclassification) ||
  !is.list(descriptive_weight_qc$age_pattern)
) {
  stop("The diagnostic artifact does not contain the complete three-method descriptive comparison.")
}
```

## Method-specific tercile reclassification

The weight-normalized and PFVC-normalized metric terciles are constructed
independently on the same method-specific metric sample, using tie-preserving
boundaries. These are cohort-relative categories, not clinical injury
thresholds. Results from different method samples are not necessarily paired
comparisons.

```{r}

  descriptive_weight_qc$reclassification$summary,

  landscape = FALSE
)
```

## Sex-specific fitted age curves

Each method uses the same three-degree-of-freedom spline model structure with
age-by-sex and age-by-race interactions. Curves are shown separately by sex at
the White race reference category. The exponentiated fitted log-ratio is not
the arithmetic mean weight/PFVC ratio.

These are descriptive model-based relationships, not causal demographic effects
or measurements of lung volume. The existing bottom panel of the Part 1b figure
retains the original McLaren reclassification analysis.

```{r}

  descriptive_weight_qc$age_pattern$model_diagnostics,
  landscape = FALSE
)
```

## Figure layout and review status

The Part 1 PDF is configured as two pages:

- Page 1 top: shared three-method age curves.
- Page 1 bottom: McLaren reclassification.
- Page 2 top: NCHS reclassification.
- Page 2 bottom: actual-body-weight reclassification.

Runtime checks validate the plot objects and output files. They do not establish

# Prognostic utility for 60-day mortality

Each outcome analysis is repeated under seven separate alternative adjustment
specifications. VT/weight and VT/PFVC variables are tidal-volume normalizations;
weight/PFVC variables are size ratios, not tidal-volume measurements. The
mechanic definitions and PBW-versus-PFVC locked comparisons remain unchanged.

A common complete-case sample is used within each mechanic family across the
alternatives and adjustment levels. These model-specific exclusions do not
change the upstream cohort or descriptive discordance/reclassification samples.

## AIC and C-statistic comparison

Delta AIC is calculated among the five mechanic specifications within each
mechanic family, alternative adjustment specification, and adjustment level.
It is not a ranking of the seven alternatives. C-statistics are apparent
in-sample estimates, not externally validated discrimination.

```{r}
prognostic_fit_report <- normalization_qc$prognostic_utility$fit_comparison %>%
  transmute(
    Family = family,
    `Adjustment alternative` = normalization_label,
    Specification = as.character(spec),
    Adjustment = adjusted,
    N = n,
    Deaths = n_events,
    AIC = aic,
    `Delta AIC` = delta_aic,
    `C-statistic` = auc,
    `Computationally usable` = computationally_usable,
    Status = comparison_status
  )

show_table(landscape_section = TRUE, prognostic_fit_report, digits = 3, landscape = FALSE, character_width = "3.8cm")
```

## Exposure coefficient export

These coefficients describe the log-transformed mechanic exposure conditional
on the selected alternative and remaining covariates. The displayed OR per SD
uses the standard deviation of the log-transformed exposure in the common
mechanic-family sample. Coefficients for the alternative adjustment variable
itself are not included in this export.

```{r}
prognostic_coefficient_report <- normalization_qc$prognostic_utility$coefficient_export$data %>%
  transmute(
    Family = family,
    `Adjustment alternative` = normalization_label,
    Specification = spec,
    Adjustment = adjusted,
    Term = term,
    `Log-exposure SD` = sd_log,
    `OR per SD` = or_per_sd,
    `CI low` = or_per_sd_lo,
    `CI high` = or_per_sd_hi,
    `P value` = p_value,
    N = n,
    Deaths = n_events,
    `Computationally usable` = computationally_usable,
    Status = comparison_status
  )

show_table(landscape_section = TRUE, prognostic_coefficient_report, digits = 3, landscape = FALSE, character_width = "3.7cm")
```

```{=latex}
\EndDiagnosticLandscape
```

# Form-versus-physiology decomposition

Locked-versus-separate comparisons use nested one-parameter likelihood-ratio
tests. PBW-versus-PFVC comparisons within a form are nonnested and use AIC
differences. Positive physiology delta AIC values favor PFVC.

# Validated analysis-output inventory

Script 05 validates 19 analysis artifacts: 14 CSV files and 5 PDF files.
The two-page Part 1 PDF counts as one file.

The inventory below reflects the saved analysis artifact. Report rendering is a separate workflow.
A pre-existing diagnostic PDF does not establish reporting completion for the current analysis.
The separate reporting workflow must validate all 20 deliverables: 14 CSV files and 6 PDF files,
including this diagnostic report.

```{r}
#| label: normalization-analysis-output-inventory

if (!is.data.frame(normalization_qc$output_manifest)) {
  stop("The diagnostic artifact does not contain the finalized analysis-output manifest.")
}

required_manifest_columns <- c("output", "path", "exists", "nonempty", "size_bytes", "extension")
missing_manifest_columns <- setdiff(
  required_manifest_columns,
  names(normalization_qc$output_manifest)
)

if (length(missing_manifest_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The analysis-output manifest is missing column(s): ",
    paste(missing_manifest_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!is.list(normalization_qc$reporting)) {
  stop("The diagnostic artifact does not contain the separate reporting-workflow status.")
}

section_outputs <- normalization_qc$output_manifest %>%
  transmute(
    Output = output,
    File = basename(path),
    Exists = exists,
    Nonempty = nonempty,
    `Size (KB)` = round(size_bytes / 1024, 1)
  )

show_table(section_outputs)
```

## Reporting status recorded in the input artifact

This is the status stored in the diagnostic RDS used to render the report, not a claim about
the success of the render currently in progress.

```{r}
#| label: normalization-reporting-input-status

reporting_status_table <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "Reporting status in input artifact",
    "Script 05 rendered the report",
    "Expected analysis files",
    "Expected report-inclusive files",
    "Intended diagnostic PDF"
  ),
  value = c(
    normalization_qc$reporting$status,
    as.character(normalization_qc$reporting$report_rendered_by_script05),
    as.character(nrow(normalization_qc$output_manifest)),
    as.character(normalization_qc$reporting$report_inclusive_expected_file_count),
    basename(normalization_qc$reporting$intended_output)
  )
)

show_table(reporting_status_table)
```
